provenance.original: TSA estimates that each electronic submission (via emails and online tool) takes 5 minutes (0.083 hours) for a contractor and 30 seconds (0.0083 hours) for a federal employee to review. provenance.original: In the future, individuals may return to an enrollment location after their enrollment to provide biometrics that may not have been captured during their initial enrollment or renewal.  During the launch of the TPAP, fingerprints were the only required biometric for an individual’s application.  TSA may use additional biometrics, such as a facial image, at the airport checkpoint for identity verification to ensure the individual is the applicant granted eligibility for the program.  TSA estimates certain individuals, such as those enrolled in the TPAP prior to the collection of the facial image and/or iris scan biometric or in other TSA PreCheck-eligible populations, without the additional biometrics requirements, may choose to provide additional biometrics.  The time submission burden is derived from the estimated number of online renewals, multiplied by the percentage of those providing biometrics post-enrollment (20 percent), and the estimated time for submission (5 minutes) plus travel (40 minutes), or 45 minutes.  Table 6 provides the estimated total hours for applicants that provide biometrics post-enrollment.

provenance.original: Implementation Plan Reviews: TSA estimates it will conduct 73 Cybersecurity Implementation Plan reviews utilizing a manager and an analyst.  This is a one-time review, and the manager will spend 8 hours conducting the review, while the analyst will spend 24 hours.  TSA uses a K-band rate of $102.20 for the manager and J-band rate of $87.11 for the analyst.  The total cost of implementation plan reviews is 73 x ((8 hours x $102.20) + (24 hours x $87.11)) = $212,302.

provenance.original: TSA conducts approximately 70 assessments for PTPR respondents annually.  A PTPR assessment takes approximately 9 hours.  This results in an PTPR annual hour burden of 630 hours, or 1,890 hours over 3 years.  To estimate costs, TSA uses a fully-loaded wage rate of $62.70 for PTPR respondents.  TSA estimates an annual hour burden cost of $39,499. for this collection, or $118,498 over 3 years.  Table 1 summarizes these calculations.
